name: Cerebral
detailed_description:
Cerebral is a psychological horror game where your only way out is through a series of disturbing footage. Watch closely and print clues revealed in frames to manipulate the world around you.

Be careful. Some things are never meant to be revealed.

STORY

It started with a video. A cursed file from your missing roommate. You watched it. You shouldn’t have.

Now your room is not yours anymore. No doors. No windows. No escape.

Just a laptop, a printer, and a chilling message inked on the printed page:

REMEMBER. REVEAL. RESTORE.

GAMEPLAY FEATURES

  • Investigate Cursed Footage: Pause, zoom, navigate frame-by-frame, and adjust brightness like a real video player. Uncover hidden details buried in the recordings that are directly tied to your room.

  • Print to Escape: Print clues revealed in frames to alter your reality and move closer to the truth.

  • Replayable Terror: Experience randomized events, unpredictable secrets, and multiple endings. Each playthrough builds new tension. Will this be the one where you finally escape?

  • Slow-Burn Psychological Horror: No cheap jumpscares. Around one hour of dread, mystery, and mind-bending unease that lingers long after the screen fades to black.
